findings.current: The hereditary martial art created by some fellow called the founder—or was it the family’s founding granddad?—was unbelievably complicated.
findings.defect: The replacement joke about a “founding granddad” loses the source’s explicit wordplay between 시조, “founder,” and 시조새, “Archaeopteryx.”
findings.rationale: The source deliberately turns “founder” into the similar-sounding “Archaeopteryx,” a comic beat characterizing Taekyung’s irreverent narration.
findings.replacement: The hereditary martial art created by some fellow called the founder—or was it Archaeopteryx?—was unbelievably complicated.
findings.source: 시조인가 시조새인가 하는 양반이 만들었다는 가전 무공은 더럽게 복잡했다.

findings.current: I thought the game’s language system had glitched. Fortunately, it meant exactly what I thought it meant.
findings.defect: This repeats the preceding thought about the language system and omits the source beat in which the warriors accompanying Wipeng join Taekyung’s laughter.
findings.rationale: The omitted group laughter establishes the falsely convivial atmosphere immediately before Wipeng resumes reading the arrest order.
findings.replacement: Laughter was contagious. The warriors who had come with Wipeng began laughing along with me.
findings.source: 원래 웃음은 전염되기 마련이다. 위팽과 같이 온 무사들도 나를 따라 웃기 시작했다.

findings.current: Elder Council
findings.defect: The established name of the family body is rendered with a non-glossary variant throughout the scene.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary fixes 장로원 as “Council of Elders,” and consistent naming matters because it is a specific political body within the Jin Family.
findings.replacement: Council of Elders
findings.source: 장로원

findings.current: **Excellent Grain-Repelling Pill**
findings.defect: The item name does not use the established translation for 벽곡단.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary fixes 벽곡단 as “fasting pills”; this is a recurring named consumable whose terminology continues into the following chapter.
findings.replacement: **Excellent Fasting Pill**
findings.source: [뛰어난 벽곡단]

findings.current: - Your fatigue has been restored.
findings.defect: The English reverses the System effect by saying that fatigue itself is restored rather than relieved.
findings.rationale: The pill removes Taekyung’s fatigue; the current line literally indicates that his fatigue returns, contradicting both the source and his immediately improved condition.
findings.replacement: - Your fatigue has been relieved.
findings.source: - 피로가 회복됩니다.

findings.current: I launched into the form.
findings.defect: The translation omits that Taekyung begins the second form.
findings.rationale: Here 이 is the Sino-Korean numeral “two,” following the earlier identification of 일 초식 as the first form; the number tracks his progression through the spear technique.
findings.replacement: I launched into the second form.
findings.source: 이 초식이 시작됐다.

findings.current: “Is it true that you tried to rape the daughter of the Mount Heng Sword Sect?”
findings.defect: The translation turns a woman affiliated with the sect into the sect’s literal “daughter” and makes the source’s euphemistic allegation more explicit.
findings.rationale: 항산검문의 여식 identifies the alleged victim as a woman of the Mount Heng Sword Sect, while 범하려 한 uses the euphemistic “tried to violate”; the replacement preserves both the relationship and degree of explicitness.
findings.replacement: “Is it true that you tried to violate a woman of the Mount Heng Sword Sect?”
findings.source: “항산검문의 여식을 범하려 한 것이 사실입니까?”

findings.current: *Attempted rape?*
findings.defect: The translation narrows the allegation from attempted sexual assault to attempted rape.
findings.rationale: 성폭행 denotes sexual assault and does not by itself specify the narrower offense of rape.
findings.replacement: *Attempted sexual assault?*
findings.source: ‘성폭행 미수?’

findings.current: They all said roughly the same thing: Jin Taekyung had gotten thoroughly drunk, gone to the wrong room, and found that the room belonged to the daughter of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.defect: The witness-summary passage again changes a woman of the sect into the sect’s literal daughter.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the room’s occupant by her affiliation with the Mount Heng Sword Sect, not by assigning a literal parent-child relationship to the sect.
findings.replacement: They all said roughly the same thing: Jin Taekyung had gotten thoroughly drunk, gone to the wrong room, and found that the room belonged to a woman of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.source: 진태경이 거나하게 취해서 방을 잘못 찾았고, 그 방의 주인이 항산검문의 여식이었다는 것.

findings.current: I faced Lee Seogeun on the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s main training ground.
findings.defect: The named location 대연무장 is rendered generically instead of using the established term.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 대연무장 as “Grand Training Ground.”
findings.replacement: I faced Lee Seogeun on the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s Grand Training Ground.
findings.source: 이소군과 마주 선 이곳은 태원진가의 대연무장이다.

findings.current: “Did you think I spent three hours focusing on only one thing?”
findings.defect: Three shichen has been reduced to three hours, halving the stated duration.
findings.rationale: A shichen is approximately two hours, and the glossary requires the traditional unit to be preserved.
findings.replacement: “Did you think I spent three shichen focusing on only one thing?”
findings.source: 내가 세 시진 동안 하나만 붙잡고 있었을까 봐?

findings.current: “It’s a messenger hawk.”
findings.defect: The established courier-bird term is rendered as a hawk.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 전서응 as “messenger eagle.”
findings.replacement: “It’s a messenger eagle.”
findings.source: “전서응(傳書鷹)입니다.”

findings.current: Or maybe the Elder Council, which had been constantly watching for an opportunity, had caused some kind of incident.
findings.defect: The established name of the family body is not used.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 장로원 as “Council of Elders.”
findings.replacement: Or maybe the Council of Elders, which had been constantly watching for an opportunity, had caused some kind of incident.
findings.source: 호시탐탐 기회를 엿보고 있는 장로원에서 큰 사건을 터트렸을 수도 있다.

findings.current: - As a result of repeated training, **Sinews** and **Bones** have each increased by 1.
findings.defect: Two distinct System attributes are truncated into generic body parts, omitting the meridian and muscle components of their names.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 근맥 as “Sinews and Meridians” and 근골 as “Muscles and Bones”; these are System attributes rather than ordinary anatomical descriptions.
findings.replacement: - As a result of repeated training, **Sinews and Meridians** and **Muscles and Bones** have each increased by 1.
findings.source: - 반복 수련의 결과로 근맥과 근골이 1씩 상승합니다.

findings.defect: The displayed Fame value has been changed from 70 to 73.
findings.rationale: The source Status Window explicitly displays 70; silently reconciling it with prior events alters a stated System quantity.
findings.source: 명성 : 70

findings.current: “Are you sure? You swear that on the name of the Medicine King Hall Leader?”
findings.defect: The established office title is rendered as “Leader” rather than “Master.”
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 약왕당주 as “Medicine King Hall Master.”
findings.replacement: “Are you sure? You swear that on the name of the Medicine King Hall Master?”
findings.source: “확실해? 약왕당주의 이름을 걸고?”

findings.current: “Listen to this young bastard. I ought to shove a large needle straight into his perineal acupoint!”
findings.defect: The named acupoint is replaced with a generic anatomical description.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 회음혈 as “Huiyin Acupoint,” preserving the specific acupoint being threatened.
findings.replacement: “Listen to this young bastard. I ought to shove a large needle straight into his Huiyin Acupoint!”
findings.source: “어린 노무 새끼가 말하는 본새 보소. 대침으로 회음혈을 쑤셔 버릴라.”

findings.current: The Elder Council demanded your attendance.
findings.defect: The established name of the family body is not used.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 장로원 as “Council of Elders.”
findings.replacement: The Council of Elders demanded your attendance.
findings.source: 장로원에서 네 출석을 요구했거든.

findings.current: “The man himself said he didn’t do it! And as the Medicine King Hall Leader said earlier, Lee Seogeun was perfectly fine—”
findings.defect: The established office title is rendered as “Leader” rather than “Master.”
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 약왕당주 as “Medicine King Hall Master.”
findings.replacement: “The man himself said he didn’t do it! And as the Medicine King Hall Master said earlier, Lee Seogeun was perfectly fine—”
findings.source: “본인이 아니라고 하지 않소! 그리고 앞서 약왕당주가 말했듯이 이소군은 멀쩡했…….”

findings.current: The family’s highest-ranking elder and the head of the Elder Council.
findings.defect: The established name of the family body is not used.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 장로원 as “Council of Elders.”
findings.replacement: The family’s highest-ranking elder and the head of the Council of Elders.
findings.source: 가문의 최고 웃어른이자 장로원의 수장.

findings.current: “The situation is not good, either. According to our outside sources, rumors that Lee Seogeun was poisoned have begun spreading, and the main family’s reputation is falling.”
findings.defect: 독살당했다 means Lee Seogeun was poisoned to death, but the translation only says he was poisoned, leaving the fatal consequence unstated.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes fatal poisoning, which is the event driving the war.
findings.replacement: “The situation is not good, either. According to our outside sources, rumors that Lee Seogeun was poisoned to death have begun spreading, and the main family’s reputation is falling.”
findings.source: “상황도 좋지 않습니다. 외부 소식통에 의하면 이소군이 독살당했다는 소문이 퍼지면서 본가의 평판이 추락하고 있답니다.”

findings.current: A courtesan at Honghwaru—and my precious little finger. That thing.
findings.defect: The literal rendering of 새끼손가락 obscures the Korean gesture-based euphemism for a girlfriend or woman, making Taekyung’s comic description unintelligible in English.
findings.rationale: The source jokingly identifies Wolhwa as Jin Taekyung’s woman through a familiar euphemism; it is not describing an actual finger or calling her precious.
findings.replacement: A courtesan at Honghwaru—and my, Jin Taekyung’s, girl. You know.
findings.source: 홍화루의 기녀이자 나, 진태경의 새끼손가락. 그거.

findings.current: “That’s just Returning to the Origin…”
findings.defect: The established Murim term 반박귀진 is mistranslated and does not match the glossary.
findings.rationale: The required established rendering of 반박귀진 is “Returning to Simplicity.”
findings.replacement: “That’s just Returning to Simplicity…”
findings.source: “그건 반박귀진…….”

findings.current: - As a result of repeated practice, **Sinews** and **Bones** each increase by 1.
findings.defect: Two distinct System attributes are split into the unrelated labels “Sinews” and “Bones,” changing both attribute identities.
findings.rationale: 근맥 and 근골 are separate established System attributes: “Sinews and Meridians” and “Muscles and Bones.”
findings.replacement: - As a result of repeated practice, **Sinews and Meridians** and **Muscles and Bones** each increase by 1.
findings.source: - 반복 수련의 결과로 근맥과 근골이 1씩 상승합니다.

findings.current:
*My Sinews and Bones improving steadily must be helping, too.*

Internal energy flowed through the body’s meridians. The more I practiced a cultivation technique, and the more my Sinews and Bones improved, the wider and sturdier those pathways became. Compared to when I had started, I could circulate more internal energy at a much faster speed.
findings.defect: The explanation repeatedly collapses 근골 and 근맥 into one invented attribute, losing the mechanism that both distinct attributes improve internal-energy circulation.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly credits improvements to both 근골 and 근맥, not to a single combined “Sinews and Bones” attribute.
findings.replacement:
*The steady improvement in my Muscles and Bones and Sinews and Meridians must be helping, too.*

Internal energy flowed through the body’s meridians. The more I practiced my cultivation technique and improved those two attributes, the wider and sturdier the pathways became. Compared to when I had started, I could circulate more internal energy at a much faster speed.
findings.source:
‘근골, 근맥이 꾸준히 향상되는 덕분인 것도 있겠지.’

공력은 인체의 혈을 타고 흐른다. 심법을 수련하면 할수록, 근골과 근맥이 향상되면 될수록 혈이 넓어지고 튼튼해진다. 처음과 비교하면 보다 더 많은 공력을, 훨씬 빠른 속도로 순환시킬 수 있었다.

findings.current: **Sinews and Bones:** 105
findings.defect: The Skill Window assigns the value 105 to the wrong System attribute.
findings.rationale: The displayed source attribute is 근골, whose established name is “Muscles and Bones”; “Sinews and Meridians” is the separate 근맥 attribute.
findings.replacement: **Muscles and Bones:** 105

findings.current: I sharpened my senses and looked over each of them.
findings.defect: The translation genericizes 기감 and omits Taekyung’s activation of his established named sensory technique.
findings.rationale: 기감 is the established Skill “Qi Sense,” not merely an incidental sharpening of the senses.
findings.replacement: I activated Qi Sense and looked over each of them.
findings.source: 나는 기감을 일으킴과 동시에 그들의 면면을 훑었다.

findings.current: “Five. It was during last year’s bandit suppression campaign. One of them was a bandit chieftain. He was quite a strong bastard—”
findings.defect: 부채주 is a specific subordinate rank, Deputy Stronghold Lord, but “bandit chieftain” promotes the victim to the general leader and loses the hierarchy.
findings.rationale: The prefix 부 marks a deputy position beneath the Stronghold Lord, which matters to Hyuk Mujin’s account of his combat experience.
findings.replacement: “Five. It was during last year’s bandit suppression campaign. One of them was a Deputy Stronghold Lord. He was quite a strong bastard—”
findings.source: “다섯. 작년 산적 토벌 때였소. 그중 하나는 부채주였고. 제법 강한 놈이었…….”

findings.current: Spreading its enormous wings, the messenger hawk landed by the window of the office. It belonged to the Lower District Sect.
findings.defect: 전서응 is an eagle, not a hawk, and has an established glossary rendering.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the emergency courier specifically as a messenger eagle.
findings.replacement: Spreading its enormous wings, the messenger eagle landed by the window of the office. It belonged to the Lower District Sect.
findings.source: 거대한 날개를 펼치며 집무실 창가에 내려앉은 전서응은 하오문의 그것이었다.

findings.current:
*An eye?*

I raised my head toward the sky. The winter sky was raining down small white scraps of garbage.
findings.defect: The homonym 눈 is incorrectly read as “eye” even though Taekyung is identifying the snow beginning to fall.
findings.rationale: The following look at the winter sky and falling white flakes unambiguously establishes 눈 as snow.
findings.replacement:
*Snow?*

I raised my head toward the sky. The winter sky was raining down small white scraps of garbage.
findings.source:
‘눈?’

고개를 들어 하늘을 바라봤다. 겨울 하늘이 희고 작은 쓰레기들을 쏟아 내는 중이었다.

findings.current: “Rest easy. I don’t have a taste for tormenting people.”
findings.defect: The translation sanitizes and changes 간살, which refers to rape and murder, into generic torment, weakening Jopil’s explicit threat and characterization.
findings.rationale: Jopil is assuring the woman only that he will not sexually violate her before killing her; the source does not claim that he avoids torment generally.
findings.replacement: “Rest easy. I don’t make a hobby of rape and murder.”
findings.source: “안심하시오. 나는 간살하는 취미는 없거든.”

findings.current: “Squad Leader. There’s a kid over there.”
findings.defect: The established form of address 조장 is rendered as “Squad Leader” instead of the fixed term “Captain.”
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 조장 as “Captain” when Hyuk Mujin and the squad address Taekyung.
findings.replacement: “Captain. There’s a kid over there.”
findings.source: 조장님. 저기 웬 꼬마가 있는데요?

findings.current: By the time the carrier pigeon bearing word of war arrived, the Sakju Branch had already been surrounded so tightly that not even a drop of water could get through.
findings.defect: The established term 전서구 is rendered as “carrier pigeon” rather than the fixed “messenger pigeon.”
findings.rationale: The glossary specifically identifies this report-bearing 전서구 as a messenger pigeon.
findings.replacement: By the time the messenger pigeon bearing word of war arrived, the Sakju Branch had already been surrounded so tightly that not even a drop of water could get through.
findings.source: 전쟁을 알리는 전서구가 도착했을 때는 이미 삭주 지부가 물 샐 틈 없이 포위된 상태였다.

findings.current: What do you think is the reason he has survived until now, despite being tangled up in all kinds of grudges and vendettas?
findings.defect: The translation reduces 은원 to two synonymous forms of hostility, omitting the debts of gratitude included in the source concept.
findings.rationale: 은원 encompasses both gratitude and grudges—the full range of moral debts and enmities surrounding Jopil—not merely hostile vendettas.
findings.replacement: What do you think is the reason he has survived until now, despite being tangled up in all kinds of gratitude and grudges?
findings.source: 놈이 온갖 은원에 얽혀 있으면서도 지금까지 살아남을 수 있었던 이유가 무엇이겠소?

findings.current: The wandering martial artists thought it was fortunate that Black Mountain Blade was dead. If he had still been alive, they would have suffered something even more horrifying.
findings.defect: The second sentence changes the prospective victim from Black Mountain Blade to the wandering martial artists.
findings.rationale: The omitted Korean subject remains Black Mountain Blade: the others believe his death spared him from Jopil inflicting an even worse punishment on him.
findings.replacement: The wandering martial artists thought it was fortunate that Black Mountain Blade was dead. If he had still been alive, he would have suffered something even more horrifying.
findings.source: 낭인들은 흑산도가 죽어서 다행이라고 생각했다. 살아 있었다면 한층 더 끔찍한 일을 겪었을 테니까.

findings.current:
“I’ll carry him.”

“Yes. I’ll carry him.”
findings.defect: Taekyung’s challenge is turned into a declaration that he himself will carry Gong Yacheong, duplicating Han Yeop’s answer and changing the speaker’s intended action.
findings.rationale: Taekyung asks whether Han Yeop will carry Gong Yacheong; Han Yeop then accepts.
findings.replacement:
“Will you carry him?”

“Yes. I’ll carry him.”
findings.source:
“두고 갈 수 없으면. 네가 업고 갈래?”

“예. 제가 업겠습니다.”

findings.current: Every time I heard her shallow, wheezing breaths, a pang of unease tightened in my chest.
findings.defect: “Shallow, wheezing breaths” falsely suggests that Soyul is having respiratory difficulty; the source simply describes the small sleeping child’s soft breathing.
findings.rationale: 쌕쌕거리는 here is the audible breathing of the half-asleep child, while Taekyung’s discomfort comes from his guilt over abandoning Gong Yacheong.
findings.replacement: Every time I heard her soft breathing, a pang of unease tightened in my chest.
findings.source: 쌕쌕거리는 숨소리를 들을 때마다 가슴 한구석이 불편해진다.

findings.current: “I’ll follow your orders, Squad Leader.”
findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin’s established address 조장 is rendered as “Squad Leader” instead of “Captain.”
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes Hyuk Mujin’s address for Taekyung as “Captain.”
findings.replacement: “I’ll follow your orders, Captain.”
findings.source: “명령에 따르겠습니다, 조장님.”

findings.current: I couldn’t afford to lose a clash of qi, so I glared hard and dropped my voice.
findings.defect: The idiomatic 기 싸움 is mistranslated as a literal supernatural clash of qi, obscuring the joke that Taekyung is trying to win an intimidation contest with a wolf.
findings.rationale: In this context 기 싸움 means a contest of nerve or intimidation, not an exchange of internal energy.
findings.replacement: I couldn’t afford to lose the battle of wills, so I glared hard and lowered my voice.
findings.source: 기 싸움에서 밀리면 안 된다는 생각에 눈에 힘을 빡 주고 목소리를 깔았다.

findings.current: I tore his eyes before I left. Punishment for failing to recognize a master.
findings.defect: “Tore his eyes” is malformed and loses the specific action of ripping the dead man’s eyes open.
findings.rationale: This refers back to Jopil forcibly opening Black Mountain Blade’s frozen eyes until the flesh tore.
findings.replacement: I ripped his eyes open before I left. Punishment for failing to recognize a master.
findings.source: 고수를 못 알아본 죄로 녀석의 눈을 찢어 주고 왔지.

findings.current: “Not a wastrel. These days they call me the Sleeping Dragon.”
findings.defect: The established epithet 잠룡 is mistranslated as “Sleeping Dragon.”
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 잠룡, Jin Taekyung’s epithet and metaphor, as “Hidden Dragon.”
findings.replacement: “Not a wastrel. These days they call me the Hidden Dragon.”
findings.source: 요즘은 잠룡 소리 듣고 있지.

findings.current: “You can still stand after taking a seventh-stage Flame Divine Palm… What a high-maintenance junior.”
findings.defect: 칠 성 means seventy percent power, not the seventh stage of the technique. The current version invents a progression stage and obscures how much force Jopil used.
findings.rationale: The source quantifies the technique's output as seven-tenths of full power.
findings.replacement: “You can still stand after taking a Flame Divine Palm at seventy percent power… What a high-maintenance junior.”
findings.source: “칠 성의 화염신장(火焰神掌)을 맞고도 일어선단 말이지…… 손이 많이 가는 후배구먼.”

findings.current:
“You were unconscious for five days. Your condition was so critical that the Medicine King Hall Leader concluded you wouldn’t last the day.”

“Really?”

“Yes. When my lord heard that, he went berserk. If I hadn’t stopped him, he would have beaten the Medicine King Hall Leader to death.”
findings.defect: The established title 약왕당주 is Medicine King Hall Master, not Medicine King Hall Leader.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes this office as Medicine King Hall Master.
findings.replacement:
“You were unconscious for five days. Your condition was so critical that the Medicine King Hall Master concluded you wouldn’t last the day.”

“Really?”

“Yes. When my lord heard that, he went berserk. If I hadn’t stopped him, he would have beaten the Medicine King Hall Master to death.”
findings.source:
“닷새 동안 혼절해 계셨습니다. 상태가 워낙 위중해서 하루를 못 넘길 거라는 게 약왕당주의 결론이었고요.”

“그래요?”

“예. 그 얘기를 들은 주군께서 길길이 날뛰셨죠. 제가 안 말렸으면 약왕당주를 때려죽였을 겁니다.”

findings.current: “Number One Under Heaven.”
findings.defect: The established rendering of 천하제일인 is not used.
findings.rationale: The glossary distinguishes 천하제일인 as greatest under heaven from the stronger 고금제일인 superlative.
findings.replacement: “The greatest under heaven.”
findings.source: “천하제일인(天下第一人).”

findings.current: “Number One of All Time.”
findings.defect: The established rendering of 고금제일인 is not used.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes this distinct superlative as greatest of all time.
findings.replacement: “The greatest of all time.”
findings.source: “고금제일인(古今第一人).”

findings.current:
“The Mount Heng Twin D-Devils?”

“The Mount Heng Twin Devils.
findings.defect: Taekyung's profane mishearing of 쌍귀 as 썅귀 is reduced to an unexplained stutter, losing the joke and his coarse register.
findings.rationale: 썅 is a profanity-like distortion, while Wipeng immediately corrects it to the actual epithet 쌍귀, Twin Devils.
findings.replacement:
“The Mount Heng Fucking Devils?”

“The Mount Heng Twin Devils.”
findings.source:
“항산썅귀요?”

“항산쌍귀 말입니다.

findings.current: “How many Peak masters do you think there are in a single city? Across all of Shanxi, where our family is located, there are fewer than twenty.”
findings.defect: 성 refers to a province in this administrative comparison, not a city. The current version materially understates the geographic scale of Peak-master scarcity.
findings.rationale: The following clause explicitly uses all of Shanxi as the relevant province-wide frame.
findings.replacement: “How many Peak masters do you think there are in a single province? Across all of Shanxi, where our family is located, there are fewer than twenty.”
findings.source: “한 성(城)에 절정 고수가 몇이나 있다고 생각하십니까? 본가가 위치한 산서를 통틀어도 채 스물이 되지 않습니다.”

findings.current: That was how the debts and grudges of Murim worked. The chain of debts and grudges would not break until one of the two sides fell.
findings.defect: The established Murim concept 은원 is rendered as debts and grudges rather than gratitude and grudges, muting its explicit positive-and-negative duality.
findings.rationale: 恩怨 encompasses both favors or gratitude owed and hostile grudges; the glossary fixes the phrase as gratitude and grudges.
findings.replacement: That was how gratitude and grudges worked in Murim. The cycle of gratitude and grudges would not end until one of the two sides fell.
findings.source: 무림의 은원(恩怨)이란 그런 것이다. 둘 중 하나가 쓰러지기 전까지 은원의 고리는 끊어지지 않는다.

findings.current: “The Medicine King Hall Leader was absolutely furious.”
findings.defect: The established title 약왕당주 is Medicine King Hall Master, not Medicine King Hall Leader.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes this office as Medicine King Hall Master.
findings.replacement: “The Medicine King Hall Master was absolutely furious.”
findings.source: “약왕당주께서 노발대발하셨죠.”

findings.current: **One Flash**
findings.defect: The newly acquired named Skill is given the wrong established English name.
findings.rationale: The glossary explicitly establishes 일섬 as One Annihilation for the spear technique used to kill the Boss Zone monster.
findings.replacement: **One Annihilation**
findings.source: [일섬]

findings.current: “Hundred-year snow ginseng?”
findings.defect: The established elixir name is not used.
findings.rationale: The glossary fixes 백년설삼 as Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng.
findings.replacement: “Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng?”
findings.source: “백년설삼?”

findings.current: — Your Sinews and Bones and your Meridians improve greatly!
findings.defect: The translation conflates and misnames two distinct System attributes: 근골 is Muscles and Bones, while 근맥 is Sinews and Meridians.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly raises two separate attributes, both of which have established glossary renderings.
findings.replacement: — Your Muscles and Bones and your Sinews and Meridians improve greatly!
findings.source: - 근골과 근맥이 크게 향상됩니다!

findings.current: “Guo of the Three Paths Sect presents his respects.”[^1]
findings.defect: Both the surname and sect name conflict with established terminology. 곽 is Gwak, and 삼도문 is the Samdo Sect.
findings.rationale: The speaker is Gwak Jun, and the supplied glossary mandates Samdo Sect. The current Chinese-style surname rendering also breaks continuity with his later introduction.
findings.replacement: “Gwak of the Samdo Sect presents his respects.”[^1]
findings.source: “삼도문(三道問)의 곽 모가 인사 올립니다.”

findings.current: **Fire Divine Elixir**
findings.defect: The named item is rendered with a different, generic name instead of its established title.
findings.rationale: 열화신단 has the exact glossary rendering Blazing Flame Divine Pill.
findings.replacement: **Blazing Flame Divine Pill**
findings.source: [열화신단]

findings.current:
I started counting again from the end, one person at a time. Not counting me, there were eight. Han Yeop had serious injuries, so he obviously couldn’t have come—but Hyuk Mujin had snuck out to join us.

“…What are you doing here?”
findings.defect: The translation replaces Taekyung’s calculation with the answer before he identifies Hyuk Mujin. It omits that the original squad had nine members besides Taekyung, that both Hyuk Mujin and Han Yeop should be absent, and that only seven should therefore be present.
findings.rationale: The source builds the reveal through a numerical discrepancy. Naming Hyuk Mujin before Taekyung recognizes him removes that mechanism and prematurely resolves the surprise.
findings.replacement:
I started counting again from the end, one person at a time. There had originally been nine of them, excluding me. Hyuk Mujin and Han Yeop were both seriously injured, so neither should have been here. That meant there should have been seven, but…

“…What are you doing here?”
findings.source:
나는 끝에서부터 한 명씩 다시 세기 시작했다. 일단 나를 제외하고 아홉 명. 거기에 혁무진과 한엽은 중상이니까 당연히 오지 못했을 테니 일곱이 되어야 하는데…….

“……너 여기서 뭐 하냐?”

findings.current: More than five hundred martial artists stood in formation across the main training ground.
findings.defect: The established location name is replaced by a generic description.
findings.rationale: 대연무장 has the exact glossary rendering Grand Training Ground.
findings.replacement: More than five hundred martial artists stood in formation across the Grand Training Ground.
findings.source: 대연무장에 도열한 무사들의 숫자는 오백이 넘어갔다.

findings.current: “Squad Leader!”
findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin’s established form of address is changed from Captain to Squad Leader.
findings.rationale: The glossary explicitly establishes 조장 as Captain when Hyuk Mujin addresses Taekyung, making this a hierarchy and address inconsistency.
findings.replacement: “Captain!”
findings.source: “조장님!”

findings.current: “I’m Gwak Jun of the Three Paths Sect. We met once before… We even shook hands.”
findings.defect: The established sect name is mistranslated.
findings.rationale: 삼도문 has the exact glossary rendering Samdo Sect, and the organization is central to the ensuing betrayal.
findings.replacement: “I’m Gwak Jun of the Samdo Sect. We met once before… We even shook hands.”
findings.source: “삼도문의 곽준이라 합니다. 일전에 한 번 인사를 드렸었는데…… 손도 잡았었죠.”

findings.current: “The manual’s a Supreme Peak martial art, and if you absorb the elixir right, it’s thirty years.”
findings.defect: The source’s traditional unit 반 갑자 is converted to a modern year count despite the established glossary term.
findings.rationale: The source says half a 갑자, and the glossary requires jiazi. Although equivalent to thirty years, replacing the unit erases the Murim register.
findings.replacement: “The manual’s a Supreme Peak martial art, and if you absorb the elixir right, it’s half a jiazi.”
findings.source: “비급은 초절정 무공이고, 영단은 잘만 흡수하면 반 갑자.”

findings.current: “Of course. You’re the Sleeping Dragon.”
findings.defect: Taekyung’s established epithet is changed.
findings.rationale: 잠룡 has the exact glossary rendering Hidden Dragon.
findings.replacement: “Of course. You’re the Hidden Dragon.”
findings.source: “그럼요. 잠룡이신데.”

findings.current: “Squad Leader, please move your foot. It hurts.”
findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin’s established address for Taekyung is mistranslated.
findings.rationale: The glossary explicitly establishes 조장 as Captain in Hyuk Mujin’s dialogue.
findings.replacement: “Captain, please move your foot. It hurts.”
findings.source: “조장. 발 좀 치워 주세요. 아파요.”

findings.current: The eight said to be Jin Taekyung’s subordinates advanced slowly with their backs together, whether their leader was doing anything up ahead or not.
findings.defect: The translation changes the number of Taekyung’s subordinates from nine to eight.
findings.rationale: 아홉 명 explicitly means nine people. This changes a concrete scene quantity and contradicts the squad composition established in the source.
findings.replacement: The nine said to be Jin Taekyung’s subordinates advanced slowly with their backs together, whether their leader was doing anything up ahead or not.
findings.source: 진태경의 부하라는 아홉 명은 대장이 앞에서 뭘 하건 말건 서로 등을 맞대고 느릿느릿 전진했다.

findings.current: Of the ten or so subordinates caught in One Flash, he was the only one who even left a sound.
findings.defect: The named spear technique is rendered with the wrong established name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is the named technique One Annihilation in the supplied glossary.
findings.replacement: Of the ten or so subordinates caught in One Annihilation, he was the only one who even left a sound.
findings.source: 일섬에 휘말린 십여 명의 부하 중 목소리라도 남긴 이는 그가 유일했다.

findings.current: “One Flash. This thing is awesome.”
findings.defect: The dialogue uses the wrong name for Taekyung’s established spear technique.
findings.rationale: 일섬 must remain One Annihilation wherever the technique is named.
findings.replacement: “One Annihilation. This thing is awesome.”
findings.source: “일섬, 이거 끝내주네.”

findings.current: “If you add the Three Paths Sect and Gunggwimun together, well over a hundred.”[^2]
findings.defect: Both sect names conflict with the established glossary.
findings.rationale: 삼도문 and 궁귀문 have the exact established renderings Samdo Sect and Gunggui Sect. These identities matter directly to Taekyung’s calculation of the infiltrators’ strength.
findings.replacement: “If you add the Samdo Sect and the Gunggui Sect together, well over a hundred.”
findings.source: “삼도문, 궁귀문을 합치면 백 명이 훌쩍 넘을 겁니다.”

findings.current: “What, has it only been a day or two?”
findings.defect: The Korean is an idiom meaning that Jinho habitually comes into Taekyung’s room, not a literal question about whether one or two days have passed.
findings.rationale: The replacement restores Jinho’s breezy implication that his presence in the room is routine.
findings.replacement: “Is this anything new?”
findings.source: “하루 이틀이야?”

findings.current: “You stuck this in a piece of junk more than twenty years old before throwing it away?”
findings.defect: The translation assigns the act of putting the manual inside the capsule to Taekyung. Jinho is instead questioning why whoever discarded the old capsule would have left its manual inside.
findings.rationale: The source has an omitted generic subject and expresses disbelief about the capsule and manual being discarded together; it does not accuse Taekyung of inserting the manual.
findings.replacement: “Someone left this inside when they threw out a piece of junk more than twenty years old?”
findings.source: “20년도 더 지난 고물을 버리면서 이런 걸 넣어 둔다고?”

findings.current: People with money fought easy with magic equipment; people without it had to carry torches.
findings.defect: “Fought easy” is ungrammatical English and disrupts the narrator’s otherwise sharp, colloquial contrast.
findings.rationale: 편하게 싸우고 means fighting comfortably or easily, not “fought easy.”
findings.replacement: People with money had it easy fighting with magic equipment; people without it had to carry torches.
findings.source: 돈 있는 놈은 마법 장비로 편하게 싸우고 없는 놈은 횃불 들어야 한다.

findings.current: At best, he was first-rate. In Murim, that was exactly where he would stand.
findings.defect: The established Murim realm term 일류 is not rendered with the glossary form and capitalization.
findings.rationale: 일류 denotes the established classification First Rate here rather than a generic description of quality.
findings.replacement: At best, he was First Rate. In Murim, that was exactly where he would stand.
findings.source: 고작해야 일류. 무림에서의 그는 딱 그 정도다.

findings.current: That old Hobgoblin, using magic like this, was a monster at least one or two stages above us.
findings.defect: The translation adds “above us,” making the monster one or two stages above the entire party, including C-rank Team Leader Choi. This conflicts with the subsequent revelation that the Priest itself is C-rank.
findings.rationale: The source states that the Hobgoblin is a monster one or two tiers higher without making the whole party—including its C-rank member—the comparison point.
findings.replacement: That old Hobgoblin, capable of magic like this, was a monster at least one or two tiers higher.
findings.source: 이 정도 마법을 구사하는 저 늙은 홉 고블린은 최소 한두 단계 위의 몬스터라는 것.

findings.current: Rare Monsters were rare monsters that appeared in a given Gate only at a low rate.
findings.defect: The tautology “Rare Monsters were rare monsters” is conspicuously defective English and blunts the explanatory beat.
findings.rationale: The source explains that this monster category has a low probability of appearing in its associated Gate.
findings.replacement: Rare Monsters appeared only infrequently within a given Gate.
findings.source: 레어 몬스터는 해당 게이트에서 드문 확률로 출현하는 희귀 몬스터다.

findings.current: Even without arms, it was more than dangerous enough bare-handed.
findings.defect: Calling an armless creature “bare-handed” is contradictory. The source says its body alone remains dangerous.
findings.rationale: 맨몸으로 means relying on its bare body, not fighting with bare hands.
findings.replacement: Even without arms, its body alone was still more than dangerous enough.
findings.source: 양팔을 잃었지만 놈은 맨몸으로도 충분히 위협적인 존재니까.

findings.current: Every step it gave, a new wound opened and more blood spilled.
findings.defect: “Every step it gave” is unidiomatic and obscures that the monster is retreating step by step.
findings.rationale: 물러날 때마다 explicitly means each time it stepped back.
findings.replacement: With every step it retreated, a new wound opened and more blood spilled.
findings.source: 한 걸음씩 물러날 때마다, 새로운 상처가 생기고 더 많은 피가 쏟아졌다.

findings.current: An awl in a bag pokes through.
findings.defect: The established rendering of the idiom is not used.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 낭중지추 as “needle in a bag,” describing exceptional talent that inevitably reveals itself.
findings.replacement: A needle in a bag eventually pokes through.
findings.source: 낭중지추.

findings.current: Well, I’m not some prestigious family’s son here. And I’m sure as hell no Sleeping Dragon.
findings.defect: The established rendering of 잠룡 is replaced with a different epithet.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 잠룡 as “Hidden Dragon.”
findings.replacement: Well, I’m not some prestigious family’s son here. And I’m sure as hell no Hidden Dragon.
findings.source: 하긴, 나는 여기서 명문가 자제도 아니고, 잠룡 같은 건 더더욱 아니니까.

findings.current: Food in Murim was spicy, salty, and bland. And even then, more days than not, I couldn’t eat properly. For thirty days, my stomach had been abused with beef jerky, bigu pills,[^1] and rice balls.
findings.defect: The established English term for 벽곡단 is replaced by a romanization requiring an unnecessary footnote.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 벽곡단 as “fasting pills.”
findings.replacement: Food in Murim was spicy, salty, and bland. And even then, more days than not, I couldn’t eat properly. For thirty days, my stomach had been abused with beef jerky, fasting pills, and rice balls.
findings.source: 무림의 음식은 맵고 짜고 싱겁다. 그마저도 제대로 못 먹는 날이 더 많았다. 30일간 내 위장은 육포와 벽곡단, 주먹밥으로 혹사당했다.

findings.current: “—You bastard, you’re a ghost. I was just about to call you.”
findings.defect: The literal “you’re a ghost” is unnatural in English and loses the caller’s remark about Choi’s uncannily perfect timing.
findings.rationale: Here 귀신이네 is an idiomatic reaction to Choi calling at exactly the right moment, not a claim that he is literally a ghost.
findings.replacement: “—You bastard, are you psychic or what? I was just about to call you.”
findings.source: 이 자식, 귀신이네. 안 그래도 연락하려고 했는데.

findings.current: My martial arts, my stats, and even my steel-like Sinews and Bones had come with it.
findings.defect: The established System attribute terminology is not used.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 근골 as “Muscles and Bones.”
findings.replacement: My martial arts, my stats, and even my steel-like Muscles and Bones had come with it.
findings.source: 무공과 능력치. 그리고 강철 같은 근골까지 포함이다.

findings.current: “Luxury Nutjob? Who’s that?”
findings.defect: Team Leader Choi’s established contact display name is replaced with a different rendering.
findings.rationale: The block glossary explicitly establishes 명품충 as the display name “Designer-Brand Junkie.”
findings.replacement: “Designer-Brand Junkie? Who’s that?”
findings.source: “명품충? 누구야 이건?”

findings.current: Jinho hyung stared blankly, looking from me to the phone in my hand.
findings.defect: The phone is assigned to Taekyung’s hand, but the source says Jinho is holding it.
findings.rationale: 손에 쥔 핸드폰 refers to the phone Jinho has just been given and is currently holding.
findings.replacement: Jinho hyung stared blankly, looking from me to the phone in his hand.
findings.source: 진호 형이 멍한 얼굴로 나와 손에 쥔 핸드폰을 번갈아 봤다.

findings.current: “Squad leader, squad leader!”
findings.defect: The established form of address is replaced with a different rank.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 조장, Hyuk Mujin’s address for Taekyung, as “Captain.”
findings.replacement: “Captain, Captain!”
findings.source: 조장, 조장!

findings.current: “Why is the squad leader suddenly like this now of all times…”
findings.defect: The repeated established form of address is again replaced with a different rank.
findings.rationale: The block glossary establishes 조장 as “Captain,” and the dream voice is referring to Taekyung by that title.
findings.replacement: “Why is Captain suddenly like this now of all times…”
findings.source: 조장은 왜 갑자기 이럴 때…….

findings.current:
〈 Luxury Nutjob

Luxury Nutjob
findings.defect: The established display name is replaced with an unapproved alternative.
findings.rationale: 명품충 is explicitly established for this text-message display name as “Designer-Brand Junkie.”
findings.replacement:
〈 Designer-Brand Junkie

Designer-Brand Junkie
findings.source:
〈 명품충



명품충

findings.current:
“Because they trust me.”

“What?”

“They trust my instincts, and they trust my eye for people. That’s why I want to hold on to Jin Taekyung.”
findings.defect: The translation changes the subject from Choi trusting himself to unspecified others trusting him, inventing external Guild approval for his decision.
findings.rationale: 저를 믿으니까요 and the following repeated 믿습니다 are first-person statements about Choi’s confidence in his own instincts and judgment.
findings.replacement:
“Because I trust myself.”

“What?”

“I trust my instincts and my eye for people. That’s why I want to sign you, Mr. Jin Taekyung.”
findings.source:
“저를 믿으니까요.”

“네?”

“제 촉을 믿고, 사람 보는 눈을 믿습니다. 그래서 진태경 씨를 꼭 잡고 싶어요.”

findings.current: “Hey, HR. Process two resignations today. Kim Sangshik and Kim Sangho.”
findings.defect: The English makes the dismissals sound like voluntary resignations even though the Guild Master has just fired Kim Sangshik and orders both father and son removed.
findings.rationale: In context, 퇴사 처리 is an administrative order to terminate their employment, not a report that they chose to resign.
findings.replacement: “Hey, HR. Process two terminations today. Kim Sangshik and Kim Sangho.”
findings.source: “어, 인사팀장. 오늘 두 명 퇴사 처리 해. 김상식이랑 김상호.”

findings.current: For the next few days, Sopung Guild was in an uproar over the rare event of a father and son resigning at the same time.
findings.defect: The narration again characterizes the father and son as resigning voluntarily, obscuring the consequence of the Guild Master’s order.
findings.rationale: The preceding scene establishes that the Guild Master dismisses both men; the neutral 퇴사 cannot override that explicit context.
findings.replacement: For the next few days, Sopung Guild was in an uproar over the rare event of a father and son being forced out at the same time.
findings.source: 그 후, 며칠간 소풍 길드는 부자(父子) 동시 퇴사라는 보기 드문 사건으로 시끄러웠다.

findings.current: “One Flash.”
findings.defect: The named spear technique is rendered with a different name from the established terminology.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established in this block as “One Annihilation,” specifically the technique used to kill the Boss Zone monster in one blow.
findings.replacement: “One Annihilation.”
findings.source: “일섬(一晱).”

findings.current: Dialect burst out of me before I knew it.
findings.defect: 방언 here means speaking in tongues, not a regional dialect; the mistranslation makes the punch line semantically incoherent.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is blurting out an ecstatic, quasi-religious stream of facts about Shin Saimdang after recognizing the high-denomination bills.
findings.replacement: I started speaking in tongues before I knew it.
findings.source: 나도 모르게 방언이 터져 나온다.

findings.current: A roller coaster that dropped whenever the System disappeared…
findings.defect: The conditional fear that the System might disappear is recast as a recurring event, falsely implying that it has disappeared before.
findings.rationale: The conditional 사라지면 describes a feared future possibility, not something that repeatedly happens.
findings.replacement: A roller coaster that would plummet if the System disappeared…
findings.source: 시스템이 사라지면 추락하는 롤러코스터…….

findings.current: “Mrs. Kim is really excited now that her son’s home after so long.”
findings.defect: The established joking sobriquet 여사 is flattened into the ordinary marital title “Mrs.”
findings.rationale: 여사 is established as “Lady” when Taekyung jokingly refers to Kim Jeonghee.
findings.replacement: “Look at Lady Kim, all excited because her son’s home after so long.”
findings.source: “오랜만에 아들 왔다고 아주 신나셨네, 우리 김 여사.”

findings.current: “Our Mrs. Kim is starting again. I know how to eat boiled pork too, you know?”
findings.defect: The established joking sobriquet is again replaced with the ordinary title “Mrs.”
findings.rationale: 김 여사님 continues the established playful “Lady Kim” address.
findings.replacement: “There goes Lady Kim again. I know how to eat boiled pork too, you know?”
findings.source: “우리 김 여사님 또 시작이네. 나도 수육 먹을 줄 알거든?”

findings.current: “From you. You kept calling it in your sleep.”
findings.defect: The English incorrectly treats a person’s name as something Taekyung was “calling,” producing an unclear referent and unnatural meaning.
findings.rationale: 그 이름을 부르다 here means that Taekyung repeatedly called out or said Jin Wikyung’s name while asleep.
findings.replacement: “From you. You kept saying that name in your sleep.”
findings.source: ‘오빠한테. 아까 자면서 계속 그 이름을 부르더라고.’

findings.current: To them, I had been a Benefactor, a trusted superior, and a comrade they could turn their backs to.
findings.defect: The English reverses the trust idiom: 등을 맡길 수 있는 means entrusting one’s exposed back to a comrade, not turning one’s back on or away from them.
findings.rationale: The source specifically characterizes Taekyung as someone they trusted to protect them in combat.
findings.replacement: To them, I had been a Benefactor, a trusted superior, and a comrade they could trust to watch their backs.
findings.source: 나는 그들에게 있어 은인이었고, 신뢰하는 상관이자 등을 맡길 수 있는 전우였다.

findings.current: I had been a blood brother, too.
findings.defect: “Blood brother” commonly denotes sworn brotherhood and leaves the actual biological kinship unclear.
findings.rationale: The preceding memories are of Taekyung’s biological brother, and 피를 나눈 형제 explicitly invokes shared blood.
findings.replacement: I was also his brother by blood.
findings.source: 피를 나눈 형제이기도 했다.

findings.current: Luxury Freak.
findings.defect: The displayed contact name does not use the established translation.
findings.rationale: 명품충 is fixed in the supplied glossary as Designer-Brand Junkie.
findings.replacement: Designer-Brand Junkie.
findings.source: [명품충]

findings.current: “I’ll make him one of my people. Even if I have to pay him three personal visits.[^1]”
findings.defect: The established name of the historical allusion is paraphrased rather than preserved.
findings.rationale: 삼고초려 is fixed in the supplied glossary as Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage, and the following Zhuge Liang joke depends on that allusion.
findings.replacement: “I’ll make him one of my people. Even if it takes Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage.[^1]”
findings.source: “내 사람으로 만들 겁니다. 삼고초려를 해서라도.”

findings.current: Squad Leader
findings.defect: Taekyung’s established squad title and Hyuk Mujin’s form of address are rendered inconsistently.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary fixes 조장, specifically Hyuk Mujin’s address for Taekyung, as Captain.
findings.replacement: Captain
findings.source: 조장

findings.current:
For many years he had carried two swords. One at his chest, the other at his waist.

There was no need for more words.
findings.defect: The first sword is metaphorically harbored in the Head Elder’s heart, but the English places a second physical sword at his chest.
findings.rationale: 가슴에 품었다 contrasts the concealed purpose he has carried within himself with the actual sword at his waist.
findings.replacement:
For many years, he had carried two swords: one in his heart, and one at his waist.

There was no need for more words.
findings.source: 오랜 세월 두 자루의 검을 품었다. 하나는 가슴에, 하나는 허리춤에. 이제 더는 말이 필요 없었다.

findings.current: sixty years of internal energy
findings.defect: The established Murim unit is converted into an explanatory quantity instead of using its fixed term.
findings.rationale: 갑자 is fixed in the supplied glossary as jiazi.
findings.replacement: one jiazi of internal energy
findings.source: 일 갑자에 달하는 공력

findings.current: His aim was to lay the foundation for a prestigious house that would one day be recognized even in the Central Plains.
findings.defect: The established Murim category 세가 is replaced with a generic description.
findings.rationale: 세가 is fixed in the supplied glossary as great family.
findings.replacement: His aim was to lay the foundation for a great family that would one day be recognized even in the Central Plains.
findings.source: 장차 중원에서도 인정받는 세가(世家)의 초석을 다지고자 했다.

findings.current: Whether in one form or half a form, the old man in front of him was a master a league above Lee Cheonbaek.
findings.defect: “Whether in one form or half a form” is incoherent English and loses the source’s measurement of the old man’s superiority by a full or half move.
findings.rationale: The source says that regardless of whether the margin was one full form or half a form, the Head Elder was the superior master.
findings.replacement: Whether by a full form or half a form, the old man before him stood above Lee Cheonbaek.
findings.source: 일 초식이건, 반 초식이건 눈앞의 노인은 이천백보다 윗줄의 고수였다.

findings.current: Squad Leader
findings.defect: Taekyung’s established squad title and form of address are rendered inconsistently.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary fixes 조장 as Captain.
findings.replacement: Captain
findings.source: 조장

findings.current: The martial artists of the small and mid-sized sects known as the Five Gates of Shanxi—the Three Paths Sect, a union of three sects; the Tao-centered Byeokdo Sect; and Gunggwimun, which had been pouring arrows from the cliffs without pause—turned in an instant.
findings.defect: Two named sects are rendered under non-established names, obscuring their identities within the Five Gates of Shanxi.
findings.rationale: 삼도문 and 궁귀문 are fixed in the supplied glossary as Samdo Sect and Gunggui Sect.
findings.replacement: The martial artists of the small and mid-sized sects known as the Five Gates of Shanxi—the Samdo Sect, a union of three sects; the Tao-centered Byeokdo Sect; and the Gunggui Sect, which had been pouring arrows from the cliffs without pause—turned in an instant.
findings.source: 세 개의 문파 연합체인 삼도문, 도를 중심으로 수련하는 벽도문, 절벽에서 쉴 새 없이 화살을 쏘아 대던 궁귀문까지.

findings.current: They were no longer the clumsy third-rate martial artists they had seemed to be.
findings.defect: The formal martial realm designation is rendered as an ordinary lowercase description.
findings.rationale: 삼류 is fixed in the supplied glossary as the realm label Third Rate.
findings.replacement: They were no longer the clumsy Third Rate martial artists they had seemed to be.
findings.source: 그들은 더 이상 어설픈 삼류 무인들이 아니었다.

findings.current: Squad Leader
findings.defect: Taekyung’s established squad title and form of address are rendered inconsistently.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary fixes 조장 as Captain.
findings.replacement: Captain
findings.source: 조장

findings.current: The First Elder was a vile old monster who had lived more than sixty years with his black heart hidden.
findings.defect: The traditional duration 갑자 is flattened into ordinary years instead of using the established term.
findings.rationale: 갑자 is the traditional sixty-year cycle and is established as “jiazi” for this block.
findings.replacement: The First Elder was a vile old monster who had lived for more than one jiazi while concealing his black heart.
findings.source: 일장로는 일 갑자를 넘게 살아오며 흑심을 감춰 왔던 비열한 노괴(老怪)다.

findings.current: Sixty years. He had accumulated profound internal energy, but even that could not stop his body from aging.
findings.defect: The established traditional unit is again replaced by an ordinary year count.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly frames the passage in terms of one 갑자, not merely an approximate number of years.
findings.replacement: One jiazi. He had accumulated profound internal energy, but even that could not stop his body from aging.
findings.source: 일 갑자의 세월. 그는 심후한 공력을 얻었지만 육신의 노화까지는 어찌할 수 없었다.

findings.current: “As the Discipline Hall Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, I command you. The guilty shall abolish their own martial arts and enter the Cave of Repentance…”
findings.defect: The formal exalted family designation 대태원진가 is reduced to the ordinary family name, and 참회동 does not use its established English name.
findings.rationale: The source deliberately uses the exalted 대태원진가 in a formal judicial declaration, while 참회동 is established as “Repentance Cave.”
findings.replacement: “As the Discipline Hall Master of the great Jin Family of Taiyuan, I command you. The guilty shall abolish their own martial arts and enter the Repentance Cave…”
findings.source: 대태원진가의, 집법당주로서, 명한다. 죄인들은 스스로 무공을 전폐하고, 참회동에…….

findings.current: They were senior members of the so-called Elders’ faction.
findings.defect: The translation turns the named Council of Elders into a generic faction, obscuring the institutional affiliation.
findings.rationale: 장로원 is the established “Council of Elders,” and 계파 identifies these figures as its faction.
findings.replacement: They were senior members of the so-called Council of Elders faction.
findings.source: 소위 장로원 계파에 속하던 중진들이었다.

findings.current: “Squad Leeeader!”
findings.defect: Hyuk Mujin’s established form of address for Taekyung is replaced with a different rank.
findings.rationale: 조장 is established as “Captain” in this relationship and context.
findings.replacement: “Caaaptain!”
findings.source: “조자아앙!”

findings.current: A Skill that dumped several times my strength into a single blow—One Flash.
findings.defect: The named spear technique 일섬 is given the wrong established name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established as “One Annihilation”; the characters 一殲 specifically denote annihilation rather than a flash.
findings.replacement: A Skill that dumped several times my strength into a single blow—One Annihilation.
findings.source: 인벤토리를 활용한 공격과 순간적으로 몇 배의 힘을 일격에 쏟아붓는 스킬, 일섬(一殲).

findings.current: Sword Energy surged up, loaded with sixty years of internal energy.
findings.defect: The established traditional unit 갑자 is flattened into a year count.
findings.rationale: The source measures the Head Elder’s accumulated internal energy in one 갑자, established as “jiazi.”
findings.replacement: Sword Energy surged up, loaded with one jiazi of internal energy.
findings.source: 일 갑자의 공력을 머금은 검기가 치솟았다.

findings.current: “Naryeotagon? What a donkey of a man.”
findings.defect: The established martial-arts idiom is romanized incorrectly.
findings.rationale: 나려타곤 is established as “Narye tagon,” preserving both the named maneuver and the accompanying donkey joke.
findings.replacement: “Narye tagon? What a donkey of a man.”
findings.source: “나려타곤? 당나귀 같은 놈이구먼.”

findings.current: The sixty years of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone.
findings.defect: The traditional unit 갑자 is replaced by an ordinary year count.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly quantifies his internal energy as one 갑자, established as “jiazi.”
findings.replacement: The one jiazi of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone.
findings.source: 대장로의 단전에 웅크리고 있던 일 갑자의 공력이 전신 사지백해로 뻗어 나갔다.

findings.current: This, too, was an incomplete Hand Force, but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.
findings.defect: The martial-energy manifestation 수강 uses a non-established term.
findings.rationale: 수강 is established as “Palm Force,” distinct from Sword Force and generic Force.
findings.replacement: This, too, was an incomplete Palm Force, but it was enough to stop Jin Taekyung’s spear.
findings.source: 이 역시 불완전한 수강(手强)이었으나 진태경의 창을 멈춰 세우기에는 충분했다.

findings.current: “One Flash.”
findings.defect: Every occurrence of Taekyung’s named technique in this chapter uses the wrong established name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established as “One Annihilation,” and consistent naming matters throughout the technique’s explanation and repeated use.
findings.replacement: “One Annihilation.”
findings.source: “일섬.”

findings.current: “Then going straight into the Elder Council—was that why?”
findings.defect: The named governing body is rendered with a different English term.
findings.rationale: 장로원 is established as “Council of Elders.”
findings.replacement: “Then going straight into the Council of Elders—was that why?”
findings.source: “그렇다면 곧장 장로원에 들어간 것도?”

findings.current: “You should've struck a vital acupoint.”
findings.defect: The translation generalizes 사혈 and loses its explicitly lethal nature.
findings.rationale: 사혈 specifically means an acupoint whose strike can kill and is established as “lethal acupoint.”
findings.replacement: “You should've struck a lethal acupoint.”
findings.source: “사혈을 짚었어야지.”

findings.current: *One Flash.*
findings.defect: Taekyung’s named technique again uses the wrong established English name.
findings.rationale: 일섬 is established as “One Annihilation.”
findings.replacement: *One Annihilation.*
findings.source: ‘일섬.’

findings.current:
He was a sleeping dragon.

If he obtained the dragon pearl, he could roam the heavens.
findings.defect: The narration confuses the generic epithet 잠룡 with Taekyung’s separate title Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi and omits the established image of the azure heaven.
findings.rationale: Standalone 잠룡 is established as “Hidden Dragon,” while 창천 is “azure heaven”; the sentence deliberately develops the hidden-dragon and dragon-pearl metaphor.
findings.replacement:
He was a Hidden Dragon.

If he obtained the dragon pearl, he could roam the azure heaven.
findings.source: 그는 잠룡이다. 여의주를 얻으면 창천을 누빌 수 있는.

findings.current:
“The Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi…”

Wipeng gave a faint smirk.
findings.defect: The translation turns a brief amused exhalation into a smirk, adding a facial attitude not present in the source.
findings.rationale: 피식 웃었다 indicates a brief involuntary laugh or snort, not a sustained or contemptuous smirk.
findings.replacement:
“The Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi…”

Wipeng gave a quiet snort.
findings.source:
“산서잠룡이라.”

위팽은 피식 웃었다.

findings.current: The Sect Leader of Gunggwimun,[^1] Jin Chung, was one of them.
findings.defect: The sect’s established English name is replaced by an unestablished romanization.
findings.rationale: 궁귀문 is established as “Gunggui Sect.”
findings.replacement: The Sect Leader of the Gunggui Sect,[^1] Jin Chung, was one of them.
findings.source: 전투에 앞서 미리 절벽 위로 올라갔던 궁귀문(弓鬼門)의 문주, 진충이 바로 그런 경우였다.

findings.current: A gleaming silver tael had come flying from somewhere.
findings.defect: The currency unit 냥 is replaced with a different Chinese unit rather than the established rendering.
findings.rationale: 은자 is established as “silver nyang”; tael is not the designated unit for this translation.
findings.replacement: A gleaming silver nyang had come flying from somewhere.
findings.source: 번쩍거리는 은자 한 냥이 어디선가 날아온 것이다.

findings.current: A second silver tael landed perfectly in the storyteller’s bowl.
findings.defect: The second mention repeats the wrong currency unit.
findings.rationale: The established rendering of 은자 is “silver nyang.”
findings.replacement: A second silver nyang landed perfectly in the storyteller’s bowl.
findings.source: 두 번째 은자가 매담자의 대접에 정확히 안착했다.

findings.current: *The most handsome man of all time. A heaven-bestowed martial physique. A chivalrous hero who cannot stand injustice.*
findings.defect: The named constitution 천무지체 is paraphrased as a generic physique, losing an established Murim term.
findings.rationale: 천무지체 is the named “Heavenly Martial Physique”; the source presents it as one of the rumors attached to Taekyung.
findings.replacement: *The most handsome man of all time. Possessor of the heaven-bestowed Heavenly Martial Physique. A chivalrous hero who cannot stand injustice.*
findings.source: ‘고금 제일의 미남에. 하늘이 내린 천무지체. 불의를 보면 참지 못하는 협객.’

findings.current: I heard it from a gate guard of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.defect: The translation turns affiliation with the named Gate Guard Pavilion into the generic occupation “gate guard.”
findings.rationale: 수문각 is the established “Gate Guard Pavilion,” and 무사 identifies the source as one of its martial artists.
findings.replacement: I heard it from a martial artist of the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s Gate Guard Pavilion.
findings.source: 태원진가 수문각 무사한테 들은 거거든.

findings.current: - You have successfully completed **Qi Circulation**.
findings.defect: The translation invents a proper-name technique label instead of rendering the source action with the established verbal terminology.
findings.rationale: 운기조식 is established as the action “circulate one’s qi” and is better expressed as a verb here.
findings.replacement: - You have successfully circulated your qi.
findings.source: - [운기조식]을 성공적으로 마쳤습니다.
